audit_items.proof_trace: The runtime guard at market.move:813-814 computes `fee = flash_loan_fee_rate.int_mul(amount)` and immediately asserts `fee != 0`; if fee_rate is 0 then fee = 0 and the transaction aborts before any funds are released. Admin config (admin/emode.move:179) only enforces an upper bound (`< BPS_DENOMINATOR`), permitting a zero fee_rate, but this merely disables flash loans for that emode group (DoS) — it does not enable free borrowing because the use-time guard is unconditional on all call paths through `borrow_flash_loan_inner`.
